Build the parameter list of a HowMaHiCo report

Source: R/report-setup.R
report_params.Rd

Reads the parameters a report template declares in its YAML header, with their default values, and overlays the values given in .... Use it to get a params list outside a knit (to run a report's chunks at the console with report_setup() and the chunks of a skeleton copied by get_report_template()). run_howmahico_report() uses it too, so a misspelled parameter fails before the render starts, with the list of valid names.

Usage

report_params(template, ..., .params = list())

Arguments

template

Report template name, as for run_howmahico_report() (names used before v0.27.0 are resolved with a warning).

...

Parameter values overriding the template defaults, as Name = value pairs.

.params

Optional named list of parameter values, merged before ... (handy for passing an existing list).

Value

A named list holding every parameter the template declares.

See also

report_setup(), get_report_template()

Examples

p <- report_params("03_lcms_qc", Subset = "dda_all", MHCclass = "MHC2")
p$MHCclass
#> [1] "MHC2"
names(p)
#>  [1] "SampleSet"             "Provider"              "DataAnalysisNames"    
#>  [4] "WetLabNames"           "FolderDocumentation"   "AnnotationFile"       
#>  [7] "Subset"                "FolderData"            "PepAllSource"         
#> [10] "PepAllFile"            "FolderResults"         "FolderFigures"        
#> [13] "ProjectDir"            "Instrument"            "Software"             
#> [16] "MHCclass"              "ShortPeptideLengthMin" "ShortPeptideLengthMax"
#> [19] "TestMode"              "ResultsOverwrite"      "PlotsSave"            
#> [22] "InteractivePlots"      "CsvSave"
